title: All parametric mobile phone case PETG/PLA/TPU/ABS
author: Manufact3D_HH
description:
**Welcome to my MakerWorld page!**

Here you will find high-quality, cleanly designed, and everyday 3D models – developed with a focus on function, reliability, and straightforward printing.

### 📱 Smartphone Case Master Framework – "The Final Boss" Edition

**Everything is customizable! Literally everything!!!**

Designed for all materials: **PETG, PLA, TPU, ASA, ABS**, and more.

This OpenSCAD script is the ultimate evolution of precision-fit 3D-printed phone cases. It offers **full control** over every millimeter and every axis. Here is an overview of the features that make this model unbeatable:

🚀 **Start your own Phone Case Business!** With my **Standard/Premium License**, you get more than just a file. You get the full **OpenSCAD Framework** to create custom-fit cases for any smartphone.

- **Sell custom cases** for niche phone models.
- **Adjust fit & thickness** for your customers.
- **One license – infinite possibilities.**

#### 1\. Total XYZ Position Control

Every single cutout (Buttons, USB, Speaker, AUX, IR) is no longer fixed. You have dedicated sliders for every element:

- **X-Axis:** Lateral shift (e.g., for off-center USB ports).
- **Y-Axis:** Precise positioning of buttons along the side.
- **Z-Axis:** Vertical offset. Charging port sitting a bit low? No problem—just slide it down 0.5 mm.

#### 2\. Dynamic Dimensioning (L x W x H)

Whether it's a small mute switch or a massive volume rocker:

- **Individual Dimensions:** Define length, width, and height for every button slot separately.
- **Radius Control:** Adjust the rounding of cutouts for a perfect look and a premium feel.

#### 3\. Smart-Flex-Zone with Port Protection

The case balances flexibility with structural integrity:

- **Material Preservation:** Critical corners remain solid for maximum drop protection.
- **Automatic Bridge Protection:** The script detects button and port locations, leaving reinforcing safety bridges to ensure the case doesn't stretch or snap near the flex-cuts.

#### 4\. High-End Surface Finish

- **Global Scoop Slider:** Control the ergonomic "well" for all buttons simultaneously to ensure the perfect tactile feel.
- **Smooth-Edges:** All inner edges of the cutouts are rounded using spherical algorithms (no sharp edges against your fingers).

#### 5\. Pro-Level Special Features

- **AUX & IR Master:** Dedicated clearance values protect sensitive sensors at the top from material interference.
- **Camera Module:** Fully definable cutout with adjustable corner radii for any camera setup.
- **Minkowski-Finish:** The entire exterior is organically rounded for the best in-hand feel.

**The Verdict:** You no longer adapt to the design—the design adapts to your phone. Enter your device's dimensions once, and in seconds, you’ll have a case that fits better than any mass-produced product.

**Thanks for stopping by!**

If you like my models, I appreciate every **Like, Download, Make,** or feedback. Together, we improve the MakerWorld community one step at a time.

**– Happy Printing! :)**
